title: Andrew Berry: Way too premature to think about drafting a QB in 2027

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Andrew Berry: Way too premature to think about drafting a QB in 2027
sources.description: After Browns General Manager Andrew Berry shared insight into why the team traded Myles Garrett during a Tuesday press conference, he shifted to fielding questions about his plans for the 2027 first-round pick that the team acquired in the deal.
